items.title: Bank Of America (BAC) Buys MDSec In First Deal For Five Years
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) has agreed to acquire UK based cybersecurity firm MDSec Consulting. The deal is aimed at strengthening the bank's digital defense capabilities in response to rising AI driven cyber threats. This is Bank of America's first acquisition in five years and is expected to support its growth plans in the UK and globally.
